_comment: Rating weights. Offense and defense weights are applied to z-scores of each stat and sum to 1.0 within each side. special_teams is applied to the team total.
_comment_scoring: Implied totals: weight on actual points scored/allowed versus the efficiency composite when forming a scoring rating. 0.5 splits them evenly.
_comment_total_scale: Multiplies the combined team adjustments in the implied total. 1.0 uses them raw. Lower values shrink totals toward the league average.
_comment_blend: Weight on PRIOR season stats, indexed by week (element 0 = week 1). Week 1 leans 90% on last year; by week 9 the current season stands alone.
_comment_home_field: Points added to the home team's implied spread. Zeroed automatically for neutral-site games.
_comment_scale: Ratings are centred and scaled so league SD equals this many points of margin, making one rating point one point of expected margin.
